title: comment-scraper-mcp: an MCP server for Comment Scraper exports of Reddit and Hacker News threads
description:
comment-scraper-mcp is a small MCP server that lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients read the JSON files saved by the Comment Scraper browser extension. Each file holds one or more Reddit or Hacker News threads: the post, the comments that were fetched (score, reply depth, parent, timestamps, whether the commenter is the original poster, permalink) and how many comments were fetched, known but not fetched, and reported by the site. Exports have no author fields.

The server reads JSON exports from the Downloads folder and the folders directly inside it, or from folders passed with --dir. It gives the client four read-only tools: list_threads, read_thread, search_comments and get_comment. Comments are numbered [c1], [c2] and so on, the same way as in the extension's Markdown export, so a comment the model cites has the same number in a Markdown export of that thread. The server doesn't write or delete files and makes no network requests.

Install in Claude Code with claude mcp add comment-scraper -- npx -y comment-scraper-mcp (Node.js 20 or newer). The fields in an export are listed at https://comment-scraper.com/docs.
